control_origin: Fresh independent reviewer-authored controls for this review

controls.name: GF2 scan-order capacity weighting
controls.finding: The source report is underweighted for r>1; the example does not refute the depth theorem.

controls.name: Even-length Weyl packet boundary
controls.finding: Common guard 1-alpha^n is insufficient at n=2: one literal Green inverse is singular although character_packet_apply accepts the preliminary guard. Intended domain must exclude even n.

controls.name: Prototype zero-inverse arithmetic
controls.finding: A helper returning pow(a,p-2,p) without a zero check silently returns zero for a singular denominator.

controls.name: Phase38 exhaustive prefix ledger
controls.finding: Historical wrapper count is arithmetically consistent, but is not proof those operations ran.

controls.name: Preexisting manifest packaging model
controls.finding: The source order of inventory, hashing, rewriting, and appending produces stale manifest hash and duplicate archive member on a rerun with a preexisting manifest. Synthetic data only.
